#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    
    vector<int> prices;
    if (n > 1) {
        int balance = (a[0] % 2 == 1) ? 1 : -1;
        for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            balance += (a[i] % 2 == 1) ? 1 : -1;
            if (balance == 0) {
                prices.push_back(abs(a[i+1] - a[i]));
            }
        }
    }
    
    sort(prices.begin(), prices.end());
    int ans = 0;
    for (int cost : prices) {
        if (b < cost) break;
        b -= cost;
        ans++;
    }
    
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
